events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Towns (MIN) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gibson (MIN) makes marginal contact to the body of Jokic (DEN) during the drive but the contact does not affect his post play and drive to the basket.
Jokic (DEN) briefly hooks Gibson (MIN) prior to his shot attempt in the post.
RAR and LLB show Gibson (MIN) grabs Jokic's (DEN) shoulder during his shooting motion that restricts his movement and shot attempt.
Plumlee (DEN) and Towns (MIN) makes incidental contact with one another during the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Towns (MIN) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gibson (MIN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Morris (DEN) and give him room to avoid the contact.
LLB shows Towns (MIN) briefly wipes away Plumlee's (DEN) arm on the shot attempt but the contact does not prevent Plumlee from blocking Towns' shot.
Jokic (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Towns (MIN) during the drive and cleanly deflects the basketball on the drive.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Towns (MIN) before going out of bounds.
Beasley (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Towns (MIN) in the post.
RLS and LLB shows Gibson (MIN) makes contact to Beasley's (DEN) arm that prevents his ability to gather the ball cleanly.
Plumlee (DEN) and Gibson (MIN) makes incidental contact with one another during the rebound.
Plumlee (DEN) makes marginal contact to the body of Deng (MIN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
Plumlee (DEN) establishes a wide picking position in Deng (MIN) path but there is no contact between the two.
Bayless (MIN) never establishes the ball in the front court after the deflection.
Morris (DEN) cleanly deflects the basketball away from Wiggins (MIN).
Wiggins (MIN) and Morris (DEN) makes incidental contact with one another during the looseball.
Jokic (DEN) makes incidental contact to Deng's (MIN) arm after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Plumlee (DEN) makes marginal contact with Towns (MIN) that does not affect his balance or his ability to gather the rebound.
